cohort: 1142 delivery cases from four private and four public hospitals maternity wards in Northern Bangladesh.
finding: Previous C-section, prolonged labor, higher maternal educational level, maternal age 25 years and above, lower birth order, baby length > 45 cm, and irregular balanced diet intake significantly predicted C-section.
mod_finding: Previous C-section, maternal age, and birth order were the most common factors associated with C-section in both logistic regression and Cox proportional hazard models.
